propositions: Review gates currently read effective criteria through multiple seams, allowing project disables to be ignored and project DET criteria to disappear; a single immutable CriteriaSnapshot must serve as authoritative policy before any gate selection or model invocation.

Code-review project LLM criteria must require non-empty applies_to globs with ["**"] as the explicit spelling for repository-wide unconditional selection, while plan-review project criteria retain empty-list-legal validation through the shared _validate_applies_to.

The CriteriaSnapshot digest extends the existing _overlay_signature content hash rather than inventing a parallel digest, and reuses OperationSnapshot as the immutable authority under which the snapshot is derived.

Project overlays compiled through CriteriaSnapshot must include effective built-in criteria, project LLM criteria with source provenance, and project DET criteria in one digest-bound view; divergent reads between overlay producer and packaged-routing consumers must be eliminated structurally.

The ["**"] → ["**"] migration of project.review-phase-boundaries and the ["**"] unconditional selection on empty changed_files must preserve prior ungated behavior, verified through contract tests including the diverging empty-changed-files edge case.
